tezera vendor flow

Desktop web portal screens for the vendor account, covering every branch of the vendor mind map. Use the flow map to see each journey end to end, or click through the screens: highlighted areas are real links.

About these screens
  • Palette is the Vendor palette from brand manual v1.1: sage #70A992 primary, slate #658095 secondary, #B6C3A7 accent on #E9E7E2. Dark uses the manual's proposed vendor dark set.
  • Small tags on screens (Should, Could, Proposed, To decide) carry the priority notes from the mind map.
  • Yellow hotspots show a message instead of changing screen (for example Apply or Mark received). Download SVG saves the current screen so it can be dropped into Figma.
